Ranchi ke nagri kshetr ke kisanon ki salon purani samasya ke samadhan ki disha men relve ne pahal ki hai. ranchi-lohradga relmarg par nagri mahto toli ke samip relve andarpas ka nirman karaya jaega. mandal rel prabandhak (diaaraem) ne hatiya vidhayak navin jayasval ke sath prastavit andarpas sthal ka nirikshan kiya.
